sources.title: GitHub - NVlabs/SOMA-X: SOMA: Unifying Parametric Human Body Models
sources.snippet: Overview SOMA-X provides a canonical, differentiable representation for parametric human bodies and hands. It maps supported identity models to shared SOMA topology and rig conventions so applications can reuse one animation, retargeting, and geometry pipeline across model families. Runtime skinning and fitting are accelerated with NVIDIA Warp.
